notes.title: Animal Jam - Play Wild Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Welcome to Animal Jam - Play Wild on Steam! Starting today, both new and current players will be able to log in to Play Wild from Steam! For new players, simply download Animal Jam - Play Wild and create a new account.  If you already have an account on Animal Jam - Play Wild, simply download Play Wild on Steam and log in using the Play Wild Username and Password you have already created. We want to give a big THANK YOU to all of our Steam Testers; thank you for all of your participation and help in getting us to this point. We would love to hear about your experiences with Play Wild on Steam, so let us know!

Play Wild!
AJHQ
